hints.title: Block Compression
hints.text: Identify contiguous groups of zeros and their lengths. Substring boundaries may cut partially into boundary zero groups.

hints.title: Range Maximum Query
hints.text: Construct a sparse table over adjacent zero block length sums to answer range maximum queries in constant time.

hints.title: Boundary Endpoint Cases
hints.text: For each query [l, r], consider whether endpoints clip interior zero groups and combine the clipped boundary lengths with the interior sparse table maximum.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of binary string s
complexity.notes: Sparse table precomputes range maximums in O(N log N) and answers each query in O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scanning per query takes O(Q * N) which times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sparse table uses O(N log N) space to achieve constant-time queries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use range maximum query structures with careful handling of clipped interval boundaries.
